entities.summary: William de la Pole, 1st Duke of Suffolk, nicknamed Jackanapes, was an English magnate, statesman and military commander during the Hundred Years' War. He became a favourite of Henry VI of England, and consequently a leading figure in the English government where he became associated with many of the royal government's failures of the time, particularly on the war in France. Suffolk also appears prominently in Shakespeare's Henry VI, parts 1 and 2. William de la Pole, 1st Duke of Suffolk was a military leaders & commanders from Suffolk (1396-10-24, Suffolk–1450-05-11).
